remarks: Perched high in the coveted Delafield Island Association, this beautiful colonial with pool and cabana offers a rare combination of privacy, natural light, and effortless indoor outdoor living. Inspired by the relaxed elegance of a California design, the home unfolds with open, airy spaces and dramatic scale. A spectacular two-story wall of windows fills the eat in kitchen with sunlight, creating a striking focal point and connecting the home beautifully to the surrounding landscape. On the other hand, the family room features an oversized fireplace and expansive views of the backyard, with seasonal views of Scott Cove adding to the sense of place. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the living room, creating a natural gathering space at the heart of the home. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a deck overlooking the pool, walk in closet and private bath, complemented by four additional bedrooms that provide flexibility for family, guests and a designated office that opens out to a porch. The windows throughout this home make this home sundrenched! Outside, the property truly shines. An expansive level lawn leads to a heated gunite pool and fully equipped cabana with sink, refrigerator, lighting, bathroom, and storage. Whether hosting summer gatherings or enjoying quiet afternoons locally by the water, the setting is designed for relaxed coastal living. A premier Delafield Island location close to town, train, and beaches, makes this a truly special offering.
